quote.text: My pension goes to whoever is named on the form, not my will

promise.text: Beneficiary vs will: which one decides who gets it?

lines.text: A 401(k), IRA or life insurance policy pays whoever is named on the form, not whoever your will names.
What passes how, and how to check yours.

eyebrow.text: Check your own forms, in this order

items.text: List every retirement account you have ever had, including 401(k)s and 403(b)s from jobs you've left.
List every life insurance policy, including any provided through an employer.
List any payable-on-death bank account or transfer-on-death brokerage account you've set up.
Update anything that's wrong, blank, or names someone who has since died.

line.text: Who is named on the forms that override a will is one of the first things it raises, because it is the one most often years out of date.
